notes:
Yellow Parlophone logo on labels.
Embossed KT stamps on labels.
'Sold in U.K....' text on labels.
This version has 'Dr. Robert' on the sleeve and 'Doctor Robert' on the label.

This is a 1st press Variation B with the change of "Dr." - "Doctor". This probably occurred within a short time after the LP was first released. Still considered a 1st. 

There is also a 1st press Variation C. This variation incorporates the corrected “Doctor Robert” spelling to the Sans-serif label. That label exhibits a new layout design most notably with side one having both “Taxman” and “Eleanor Rigby” on the first line. The credits pattern of “Song (Composer)-Lead Singer” also are switched to “Song-Lead Singer (Composer)”. This probably appeared in late 1967 or 1968.
